cbv19:0.1: The Factor of Awakening Concerning the Elder Mahā Cunda
cbv19:2.1: ° The Fortunate One, lord of the world, having heard this (safeguard)
cbv19:2.2: from the elder Cunda, at that moment became free from adversity.
cbv19:2.3: It is about the strength of the factors of Awakening, we will recite that safeguard.
cbv19:5.1: at one time the Fortunate One was dwelling near Rājagaha
cbv19:5.2: at the Squirrels’ Feeding Place in Bamboo Wood.
cbv19:7.1: The factor of Complete Awakening that is mindfulness, reverend Sir, has been fully explained by the Fortunate One,
cbv19:7.2: when developed and made much of it leads to deep knowledge, Complete Awakening, and Nibbāna.
